entries.title: Psalms 122:1
segments: ¶<A Song of the going up. Of David.> I was glad because they said to me, We will go into the house of the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 122:2
segments: At last our feet were inside your doors, O Jerusalem.

entries.title: Psalms 122:3
segments: O Jerusalem, you are like a town which is well joined together;

entries.title: Psalms 122:4
segments: To which the tribes went up, even the tribes of the Lord, for a witness to Israel, to give praise to the name of the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 122:5
segments: For there seats for the judges were placed, even the rulers' seats of the line of David.

entries.title: Psalms 122:6
segments: ¶O make prayers for the peace of Jerusalem; may they whose love is given to you do well.

entries.title: Psalms 122:7
segments: May peace be inside your walls, and wealth in your noble houses.

entries.title: Psalms 122:8
segments: Because of my brothers and friends, I will now say, Let peace be with you.

entries.title: Psalms 122:9
segments: Because of the house of the Lord our God, I will be working for your good.
